subject: Encord/Ancestry - Follow up & PoC alignment
text:
Hello everyone,

Great speaking with you today. It sounds like there’s a strong fit between
Encord and your LLM evaluation & data annotation needs. I’m looking forward
to diving deeper as we scope out a potential POC.

I believe 45 minutes should be sufficient for the next session to scope
this out. Fnd our availability (PT):

   1. 10/13: 10am - 11.30am
   2. 10/14: 12pm - 1pm
   3. 10/15: 10am - 12pm

Here is the link to todays recording HERE
<https://us-12330.app.gong.io/e/c-share/?tkn=1toeqv5mhu6di1kt8jw8zobyom&g_ajs_param_origin=spotlight_followup_email>.
As a recap, we covered challenges in evaluating and annotating generative
LLM outputs (information extraction and name variation handling) and how
Encord can support this through scalable, agentic workflows that combine
pre-labelling, confidence-based routing, and production-ready
human-in-the-loop systems.

Looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Alyssa

Kind Regards

Alyssa Fleming

Account Manager

Email: alyssa@encord.com | LinkedIn
<https://www.linkedin.com/in/alyssatfleming/>

Website: www.encord.com | 832 Sansome St. San Francisco

subject: [Invite] AI Leaders Dinner @ Spruce, SF - Oct 30th
text:
Hi KG,

Hope you're doing well! Our co-founders, Eric and Ulrik, are hosting a
private AI Leaders' dinner in SF on Oct 30 at Spruce, and we'd love for you
to join.

Theme: The multimodal shift in AI - how vision is converging with language,
robotics, and embodied systems. It's an invite-only group of ~30 CxOs and
tech leaders from companies like Zipline, Skydio, Mytra and Nimble
Robotics.

For context, Encord is a $50M+ Series B ML data platform helping 200+ AI
teams (Boston Dynamics, Pi, Twelve Labs) improve training data quality at
scale.

Happy to share full details if you can make it?

Cheers,
Laura

--

Partnerships Lead
